title: Designer Spotlight (Link Page): the six layouts of the design, per-profile rules for the thirteen profiles, on the shared layout registry

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-28: program the Designer design system into the theme system the way Network is. Pass 6 (Spotlight). Design: Spotlight Layouts.html and ui_kits/products/Spotlight.jsx.

verify.evidence: Fails on main (lib/spotlight/designer-kit-content.ts does not exist) and passes here: the registry lists the six designer-kit layouts beside Network's and none for other themes, a stored designer layout validates and an unregistered one is dropped, the saved Designer preset and the default theme are unchanged, every layout has a component, the sheet and markup hold no raw colour, each of the thirteen profiles has a default layout it can use, its own accent and clean copy, and a live page carries no sample date, price or testimonial.

detail: Extends the registry from LIVE-1712 (does not fork it). lib/spotlight/layouts.ts gains DesignerKitLayoutId (`designer-kit:<stack|card-wall|story|calendar-first|shop-front|profile>`), the `designer-kit` entry and isDesignerKitLayout; NetworkKitLayoutId is split out so Network's component map and content types stay exact. SpotlightShell swaps to DesignerKitSpotlightLayout when theme.layout is a designer layout; nothing else changes. components/spotlight/designer-kit-layouts.tsx holds the six layouts (Server Component, no hooks; the design's charcoal tracked-caps buttons, Cormorant headlines with one italic ending, accent-ring seals, plaster ground, the design's own sigil marks) and designer-kit-layouts-css.ts the sheet, tokens only: the root carries data-house-theme=designer, data-site-corners=subtle (as Spotlight Layouts.html sets) and the profile, and inlines DESIGNER_TOKENS_CSS. The profile's accent ramp (the design's tokens/kits.css, read from lib/themes/designer-kits.json) is one scoped rule per page. lib/spotlight/designer-kit-content.ts holds the per-profile rules: ways in one per tool the profile has, in the design's ladder order (book, learn, gather, belong, sell, publish) with the profile's names; featured item picked events, courses, consultations, membership, shop, journal; Calendar first needs events, Shop front needs consultations to book, the other four always work; default layout per profile (stack: general, nonprofits; story: coaches, hosts, faith; calendar-first: studios, schools; card-wall: venues, wellness, markets; shop-front: creators, clubs; profile: networks). The design draws Spotlight for Interior designers only, so the other twelve are these rules. NO PRESET CHANGED: the Network probe and test assert no other preset carries a layout, so a Designer page takes a layout by storing theme.layout and theme.kit; a Designer preset that carries one needs that assertion relaxed first. VOICE CHANGES from the design: 'A letter each season.' to 'A letter, now and then.'; the 'Your city' placeholder dropped from eyebrows; door metas ('Say what the first step costs', 'Your lowest monthly price' and the other owner prompts) replaced by plain lines; the sample testimonial (Sarah and James, 'surprisingly calm') becomes a one-line sample shown in a preview only; the Furniture and makers profile reads 'custom work' and its call to action 'Ask about a piece'.. Sample dates, minutes and prices (the design's own sample numbers, including 'Free' on the 90 minute session) appear only when sampleContent is on. Story's italic ending reads the kit's on-media sand, not the accent, so low-contrast accents (Design + build, Event design) stay legible on the photo. Fonts: faces read --dz-display/--dz-sans with the named faces as fallback; the Spotlight route does not apply DESIGNER_FONT_CLASS (next/font cannot load where the suite renders), so a live page shows the named faces only where installed: decision for the lead, add the font class to app/spotlight/[handle]/page.tsx. The design's Instagram and YouTube icons were removed from Lucide 1, so the build draws Camera, Play and Mail. PROOF: renders of all six layouts through the real SpotlightShell for thirteen profiles, each beside the design's own, and desktop widths 1280 to 2000, in /mnt/project-files/designer-kit/renders/spotlight/.
